name: WayriCAD QuickTherm
description: Saved-board thermal screening with STEP models, component RC heating and copper loss transfer.
description_full: Read-only steady-state and scheduled spatial-transient thermal screening using declared dissipation, thermal paths and heat capacities. Real STEP component meshes use KiCad and FreeCAD placement; per-part RC nodes distinguish body/junction temperature and optional air/vacuum surface cooling. Source-bound Quick PI 2.5D imports transfer conductor I2R heat conservatively; imported losses stay fixed unless scheduled. Editable scanned inputs, copper-layer and vertical paths, virtual heatsinks, mounting boundaries, interactive views, playback and local HTML/JSON evidence. Optional Gmsh/CalculiX mode solves bounded 3D steady board conduction with a fixed lower face. KiCad 10 native Python, NumPy, SciPy and Matplotlib are required; STEP display also needs FreeCAD. This is not CFD or an internal component-gradient solve.
